e.summary: 年度全球最具创新力 100 家保险科技公司榜单：专家评审、评选标准与历届名单
e.summary_en: The annual list of the world’s 100 most innovative InsurTech companies: expert panel, selection criteria and previous lists
e.summary_hk: 年度全球最具創新力 100 家保險科技公司榜單：專家評審、評選標準與歷屆名單
e.body: InsurTech100（`theinsurtech100.com`）是**年度评选的「全球最具创新力 100 家保险科技公司」榜单**——官方表述是：「由行业专家与分析师组成的小组选出，是保险业每位领导者在制定数字化转型战略时都需要了解的公司」。站内结构完整且可核实：**About the List / InsurTech100 2025（历届名单）/ Process（评选流程）/ Criteria（评选标准）/ Nominations（提名）/ Timeline / FAQs / News & Research**，并附 **Global InsurTech Summit – USA** 会议。它对入选公司的实际影响也被明确写出：大量入选公司因此在保险公司与更广的保险社群中获得关注，有的被金融机构直接接洽，有的获得客户与合作伙伴的青睐。对 RIAA：这是**保险科技行业图景的一手索引**——做市场研究或求职时，「这个领域有哪些玩家、谁被认为最具创新力」比任何二手总结都直接；可与池内具体公司样本对照阅读（定价侧的 [[akur8]]、车险视觉定损的 [[tractable]]、巨灾风险的 [[zestyai]]、核心系统的 [[socotra]] 与 [[covergo]]），并与开放保险方向的 [[openinsurance]] 呼应；行业情报层已收 [[fintech-global]]（本榜单的发布方，含融资数据）与 [[insurtech-insights]]（全球最大保险科技社群与会议）；适合作行业研究、求职目标筛选与创业方向调研。
e.body_en: InsurTech100 (`theinsurtech100.com`) is **the annual list of "the world’s 100 most innovative InsurTech companies"** — in its own words, "selected by a panel of industry experts and analysts… the companies every leader in the insurance industry needs to know about as they consider and develop their digital transformation strategies". Its structure is complete and verifiable: **About the List / InsurTech100 2025 (previous lists) / Process / Criteria / Nominations / Timeline / FAQs / News & Research**, plus the **Global InsurTech Summit – USA**. It also states the practical effect on selected companies: many gained substantial awareness among insurers and the wider community, some were approached directly by financial institutions, others gained clients and partners. For RIAA: **a first-hand index of the InsurTech landscape** — for market research or job hunting, "who are the players here and who is considered most innovative" beats any second-hand summary; read it against concrete company samples already in the corpus (pricing side [[akur8]], vehicle damage vision [[tractable]], catastrophe risk [[zestyai]], core systems [[socotra]] and [[covergo]]) and against the open-insurance direction of [[openinsurance]]; the intelligence layer now holds [[fintech-global]] (the publisher of this list, with funding data) and [[insurtech-insights]] (the world’s largest InsurTech community and conference); suits industry research, target-company shortlisting and start-up research.
e.body_hk: InsurTech100（`theinsurtech100.com`）是**年度評選的「全球最具創新力 100 家保險科技公司」榜單**——官方表述是：「由行業專家與分析師組成的小組選出，是保險業每位領導者在制定數字化轉型戰略時都需要了解的公司」。站內結構完整：**About the List / InsurTech100 2025 / Process / Criteria / Nominations / Timeline / FAQs / News & Research**，並附 **Global InsurTech Summit – USA**。對 RIAA：這是**保險科技行業圖景的一手索引**——做市場研究或求職時，「這個領域有哪些玩家、誰被認為最具創新力」比任何二手總結都直接；可與池內具體公司樣本對照（[[akur8]]、[[tractable]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]、[[covergo]]），並與 [[openinsurance]] 呼應；行業情報層已收 [[fintech-global]]（本榜單發布方，含融資數據）與 [[insurtech-insights]]；適合作行業研究、求職目標篩選與創業方向調研。
